description.value: Serena's is a downtown Victoria restaurant specializing in Philadelphia-style hoagies and pizza, built around authentic Philly traditions of layered cold cuts, provolone, and fresh vegetables on a proper hoagie roll. With over 1,600 reviews averaging 4.9 stars, it has earned recognition as one of Victoria's top-rated pizzerias. A touring cyclist stopping on Fort Street can expect hearty, made-to-order meals with a reputation for fast, friendly service.
